data.name: CDR.fyi
data.description: CDR.fyi is a market intelligence and data platform for the durable carbon dioxide removal industry, tracking transactions, prices, deliveries, and supplier/buyer rankings. Structured as a Delaware public benefit corporation, it publishes quarterly market updates and operates a subscription-based data portal used by buyers, suppliers, investors, and policymakers.
